# Vendored design system

shrippen Design Default v1 (`styles.css`, `shrippen.js`, `fonts/`), copied from
`shrippen.github.io/ds-bundle/` (built by `build.sh` + `.design-sync/make-bundle.py`)
so the companion UI works offline and never loads third-party hosts.
Do not edit these files; put app-specific rules in `../app.css`.
Update by copying the three items again from the design-system repo.
